data.explanation: This is an invoice from the chimney company for the repair work done on your chimney. Pay the total amount by the deadline shown, using the IBAN given, to avoid late-payment issues. Keep the invoice as proof — craftsman services (Handwerkerleistungen) like this can often be partly deducted on your income tax return, so a tax advisor may be useful if you want to claim it. No other action is required unless you have questions about the charges.
data.tax_note: Invoices for craftsman services (Handwerkerleistungen) such as chimney renovation can be partly deducted from income tax under §35a EStG if paid by bank transfer; keep this invoice and the payment proof.
